newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end firmer on short-covering, weak stocks.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end firmer on short-covering, weak stocks.

text.p: * JGBs ended firmer on short-covering after falls on strong BOJ tankan on Wednesday. Late Tokyo stock falls also a support.
* Downside solid as dealers waiting for investor buying after Friday's May industrial output data, which is expected to be strong. Buying at long-end seen from public funds in afternoon.
